name: amfx-claims-vs-ism-percentile-research
description: amFX reproduction (22JUL22 p1): Initial Claims vs Industrial Production percentile ranking. Both series converted to rolling percentile rank (0-100 scale). Claims inverted (low claims = strong employment = high percentile). Demonstrates that production/activity data tracks employment claims at turning points. Uses FRED INDPRO and ICSA. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: INITIAL CLAIMS VS INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION PERCENTILE
# =============================================================================
# Inspired by Brent Donnelly's "soft leads hard" chart (22JUL22).
# Original: ISM New Orders (NAPMNOI, discontinued) vs Initial Claims
# Proxy: Industrial Production (INDPRO) vs Initial Claims (ICSA)
# Both transformed to rolling percentile rankings (0-100).
# Claims INVERTED: low claims = strong employment = high percentile.
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA: FRED Economic Indicators
# =============================================================================

# Industrial Production Index (monthly, FRED: INDPRO)
indpro_src = economic_indicators(series_id='INDPRO')()
indpro = ffill(indpro_src.result)

# Initial Jobless Claims (weekly, FRED: ICSA)
claims_src = economic_indicators(series_id='ICSA')()
claims = ffill(claims_src.result)

# Time index for x-axis
idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# TRANSFORMS: Rolling Percentile Rankings
# =============================================================================
# period=750 (~3 years) for responsive rolling percentile.

# Industrial Production percentile: higher = stronger output
indpro_pctile = percentrank(period=750)(indpro)

# Claims percentile INVERTED: low claims = strong = high on chart
claims_pctile_raw = percentrank(period=750)(claims)
claims_pctile = 100 - claims_pctile_raw

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Dual Percentile Overlay
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Does Industrial Production Track Initial Claims at Turns?',
    category='Soft vs Hard Data',
    y_axis_label='Percentile Ranking (0-100)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Industrial Production (INDPRO)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Initial Claims inverted (ICSA)', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=50, title='Median', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, indpro_pctile, claims_pctile)
